tables.name: inventory.locations
tables.fact_owner: A physical or logical stock custody location within one branch.

checks.name: ck_locations_temperature
checks.expression: temperature_min_c IS NULL OR temperature_max_c IS NULL OR temperature_min_c < temperature_max_c

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_locations_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Reject branch changes after the location is referenced and require every denormalized branch_id on stock facts to equal this location's branch_id.

tables.name: inventory.batches
tables.fact_owner: The regulated manufacturer lot identity for one product; quantities are not owned here.

checks.name: ck_batches_dates
checks.expression: (lot_kind='manufacturer_batch' AND expires_on IS NOT NULL AND (manufactured_on IS NULL OR expires_on>manufactured_on)) OR (lot_kind='untracked_system' AND manufactured_on IS NULL AND expires_on IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_batches_release_evidence
checks.expression: (status <> 'released') OR (released_at IS NOT NULL AND released_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_batches_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: At batch creation, mrp is the tax-inclusive Maximum Retail Price in INR for one marketed pack identified by mrp_uom_conversion_id. The referenced catalog.uom_conversions row must belong to the same organization and product, convert its marketed from_uom_code to the product base_uom_code, be active, and be effective on created_at::date; multiplier 1 identity conversions represent a marketed pack that is already the base UOM. Reject product, batch_number, lot_kind, manufacture date, expiry, MRP, and MRP UOM conversion changes after the first posted movement; lifecycle transitions remain controlled. Ordinary outbound sale, transfer-out, and purchase-return issue posting requires a manufacturer_batch in released state with document_date strictly earlier than expires_on. Expiry-date interpretation is normalized during regulated batch import. Only typed quarantine, customer-return receipt, recall recovery/release, and destruction workflows may move a non-released or expired manufacturer batch.

tables.name: inventory.inventory_documents
tables.fact_owner: The sole approved stock-posting command and source identity.

checks.name: ck_inventory_documents_totals
checks.expression: total_abs_base_quantity>=0 AND ((document_type='cost_adjustment' AND total_abs_base_quantity=0 AND total_value<>0) OR (document_type<>'cost_adjustment' AND total_value>=0))

checks.name: ck_inventory_documents_posting
checks.expression: (status NOT IN ('posted','reversed')) OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_inventory_documents_approval
checks.expression: (status NOT IN ('approved','posted','reversed')) OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_inventory_documents_recall_context
checks.expression: (document_type IN ('recall_quarantine','recall_recovery','recall_release') AND recall_id IS NOT NULL) OR (document_type='destruction') OR (document_type NOT IN ('recall_quarantine','recall_recovery','recall_release','destruction') AND recall_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_inventory_documents_transfer_branches
checks.expression: (document_type='transfer' AND destination_branch_id IS NOT NULL) OR (document_type<>'transfer' AND destination_branch_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_inventory_documents_physical_movement_snapshot
checks.expression: (NOT physical_movement_required AND num_nonnulls(origin_address_line1,origin_address_line2,origin_city,origin_state_code,origin_pincode,destination_address_line1,destination_address_line2,destination_city,destination_state_code,destination_pincode,transport_mode,distance_km,transporter_party_id,transporter_name_snapshot,transporter_gstin_snapshot,vehicle_number_snapshot,vehicle_type_snapshot,transport_document_number_snapshot,transport_document_date,movement_started_at)=0) OR (physical_movement_required AND btrim(origin_address_line1)<>'' AND btrim(origin_city)<>'' AND origin_state_code~'^[0-9]{2}$' AND origin_pincode~'^[0-9]{6}$' AND btrim(destination_address_line1)<>'' AND btrim(destination_city)<>'' AND destination_state_code~'^[0-9]{2}$' AND destination_pincode~'^[0-9]{6}$' AND transport_mode IN ('road','rail','air','ship','multimodal','in_person') AND distance_km>=0 AND movement_started_at IS NOT NULL AND ((transport_mode='road' AND vehicle_number_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND vehicle_type_snapshot IN ('regular','over_dimensional_cargo')) OR (transport_mode IN ('rail','air','ship','multimodal') AND transport_document_number_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND transport_document_date IS NOT NULL) OR transport_mode='in_person') AND ((transporter_gstin_snapshot IS NULL) OR transporter_gstin_snapshot~'^[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{13}$'))

indexes.name: ix_inventory_documents_status_date
indexes.purpose: Posting work queue and document history.

indexes.name: uq_inventory_documents_invoice_source
indexes.purpose: One stock document per direct invoice.

indexes.name: uq_inventory_documents_sales_return_source
indexes.purpose: One stock document per sales return.

indexes.name: uq_inventory_documents_receipt_source
indexes.purpose: One stock document per goods receipt.

indexes.name: uq_inventory_documents_purchase_return_source
indexes.purpose: One stock document per purchase return.

indexes.name: ix_inventory_documents_recall_context
indexes.purpose: Posted inventory action history for one recall.

indexes.name: uq_inventory_documents_supplier_invoice_source
indexes.purpose: Exactly one landed-cost adjustment document per supplier invoice.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_inventory_documents_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Posting validates source/document type, recomputes header totals from lines, freezes header, physical logistics snapshot and lines, and atomically emits the complete ledger set exactly once. branch_id is the source branch. Every transfer has an explicit destination_branch_id; transfer from_location belongs to the source branch and to_location belongs to the destination branch. Ordinary outbound sale, transfer-out, and purchase-return issue lines require a released, unexpired manufacturer batch with document_date < expires_on.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_inventory_documents_invariant_2
cross_row_invariants.rule: Each posted source document owns exactly one inventory document; reversal creates a new inverse document and never mutates posted evidence.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_inventory_documents_landed_cost
cross_row_invariants.rule: A posted cost_adjustment is sourced by exactly one posted supplier invoice, uses moving_weighted_average, and its signed line allocations equal eligible supplier-invoice price variances and capitalized charge facts exactly; reversal posts inverse value adjustments.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_inventory_documents_physical_logistics
cross_row_invariants.rule: A posted sales issue, purchase-return issue, or inter-branch transfer freezes one complete origin/destination, pincode, mode, distance, transporter, vehicle or transport-document, and movement-start snapshot. E-way evidence binds this physical inventory document and may additionally bind its fiscal tax document; mutable branch, party, or address rows are never treated as the movement snapshot.

tables.name: inventory.inventory_document_lines
tables.fact_owner: Typed requested stock movement or counted stock observation within one inventory document.

checks.name: ck_inventory_document_lines_location_shape
checks.expression: (movement_kind='receipt' AND from_location_id IS NULL AND to_location_id IS NOT NULL) OR (movement_kind='issue' AND from_location_id IS NOT NULL AND to_location_id IS NULL) OR (movement_kind='transfer' AND from_location_id IS NOT NULL AND to_location_id IS NOT NULL AND from_location_id<>to_location_id) OR (movement_kind='count_adjustment' AND from_location_id IS NOT NULL AND to_location_id IS NULL) OR (movement_kind='value_adjustment' AND from_location_id IS NOT NULL AND to_location_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_inventory_document_lines_count_shape
checks.expression: (movement_kind='count_adjustment' AND system_quantity IS NOT NULL AND counted_quantity IS NOT NULL AND variance_quantity=counted_quantity-system_quantity) OR (movement_kind NOT IN ('count_adjustment','value_adjustment') AND system_quantity IS NULL AND counted_quantity IS NULL AND variance_quantity IS NULL AND base_quantity>0) OR (movement_kind='value_adjustment' AND system_quantity IS NULL AND counted_quantity IS NULL AND variance_quantity IS NULL AND entered_quantity=0 AND base_quantity=0)

checks.name: ck_inventory_document_lines_cost
checks.expression: unit_cost>=0 AND ((movement_kind<>'value_adjustment' AND extended_cost=round(base_quantity*unit_cost,2)) OR (movement_kind='value_adjustment' AND extended_cost<>0))

checks.name: ck_inventory_document_lines_cost_allocation
checks.expression: (movement_kind='value_adjustment' AND supplier_invoice_line_id IS NOT NULL AND cost_allocation_method IN ('direct','quantity_weighted','value_weighted') AND cost_allocation_weight>0 AND cost_allocation_weight<=1 AND ((cost_allocation_method='direct' AND cost_allocation_basis_quantity IS NULL AND cost_allocation_basis_value IS NULL) OR (cost_allocation_method='quantity_weighted' AND cost_allocation_basis_quantity>0 AND cost_allocation_basis_value IS NULL) OR (cost_allocation_method='value_weighted' AND cost_allocation_basis_value>0 AND cost_allocation_basis_quantity IS NULL))) OR (movement_kind<>'value_adjustment' AND supplier_invoice_line_id IS NULL AND cost_allocation_method IS NULL AND cost_allocation_basis_quantity IS NULL AND cost_allocation_basis_value IS NULL AND cost_allocation_weight IS NULL)

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_inventory_document_lines_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Validate product/batch, location/branch, source-line/product, UOM conversion, movement direction, count fields, and extended cost before posting.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_inventory_document_lines_invariant_2
cross_row_invariants.rule: A transfer line emits exactly one transfer_out and one equal-quantity equal-cost transfer_in ledger entry; stock-count zero variance remains evidence without a ledger row.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_inventory_document_lines_landed_cost_allocation
cross_row_invariants.rule: For each supplier_invoice_line_id, locked cost-adjustment lines have weights summing exactly to 1 and signed extended_cost summing exactly to the eligible price variance or capitalized charge; each target batch/location must have positive on-hand and match the allocated receipt/product lineage.

tables.name: inventory.stock_ledger_entries
tables.fact_owner: The only authoritative signed on-hand and inventory-value movement.

checks.name: ck_stock_ledger_quantity
checks.expression: (entry_kind='value_adjustment' AND quantity_delta=0 AND value_delta<>0) OR (entry_kind<>'value_adjustment' AND (quantity_delta<>0 OR (entry_kind='reversal' AND quantity_delta=0 AND value_delta<>0)))

checks.name: ck_stock_ledger_cost
checks.expression: unit_cost>=0 AND ((quantity_delta<>0 AND value_delta=round(quantity_delta*unit_cost,2)) OR (quantity_delta=0 AND entry_kind IN ('value_adjustment','reversal') AND value_delta<>0))

checks.name: ck_stock_ledger_sign
checks.expression: (entry_kind IN ('receipt','transfer_in','count_gain') AND quantity_delta>0) OR (entry_kind IN ('issue','transfer_out','count_loss') AND quantity_delta<0) OR entry_kind IN ('value_adjustment','reversal')

indexes.name: ix_stock_ledger_identity_time
indexes.purpose: Rebuild on-hand and valuation in deterministic order.

indexes.name: uq_stock_ledger_reverses_once
indexes.purpose: A ledger entry is reversed at most once.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_stock_ledger_entries_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the inventory posting function may insert; UPDATE and DELETE are rejected, branch must equal location.branch_id, quantity is signed, and value/cost snapshots are derived from locked costing state.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_stock_ledger_entries_invariant_2
cross_row_invariants.rule: Exactly one ledger set exists for each posted document line; reversals use new inverse entries and each original entry is reversed at most once.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_stock_ledger_entries_landed_cost
cross_row_invariants.rule: A value_adjustment has zero quantity and signed allocated value, changes inventory value but not on-hand, and snapshots the resulting nonnegative moving weighted average unit_cost; the projector rejects adjustment of an empty stock identity and reverses with an inverse zero-quantity entry.

tables.name: inventory.stock_balances
tables.fact_owner: A synchronous rebuildable projection of on-hand quantity and value from the stock ledger only.

indexes.name: ix_stock_balances_branch_product
indexes.purpose: FEFO and stock availability reads; reservations are subtracted by the read query.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_stock_balances_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the inventory ledger projector may write; branch must equal location.branch_id and projection must equal the signed ledger fold for its non-null lot identity.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_stock_balances_invariant_2
cross_row_invariants.rule: on_hand_quantity excludes reservations; availability is computed as on_hand minus active reservation quantities at read/allocation time.

tables.name: inventory.reservations
tables.fact_owner: A temporary claim on one non-null stock lot identity; it never changes on-hand.

checks.name: ck_reservations_terminal
checks.expression: (status='active' AND terminal_at IS NULL AND consumed_by_inventory_document_line_id IS NULL) OR (status='consumed' AND terminal_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_by_inventory_document_line_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status IN ('released','cancelled','expired') AND terminal_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_by_inventory_document_line_id IS NULL)

indexes.name: ix_reservations_active_identity
indexes.purpose: Subtract active claims from on-hand and lock stock identities.

indexes.name: uq_reservations_active_order_identity
indexes.where: status='active' AND order_line_id IS NOT NULL
indexes.purpose: One active order claim per lot identity.

indexes.name: uq_reservations_active_invoice_identity
indexes.where: status='active' AND invoice_line_id IS NOT NULL
indexes.purpose: One active direct-invoice claim per lot identity.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_reservations_invariant_1
cross_row_invariants.rule: Lock the stock identity, enforce branch/location/product/batch consistency, and prevent total active reservations from exceeding on-hand quantity.

cross_row_invariants.name: inventory_reservations_invariant_2
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only controlled transitions release, consume, cancel, or expire a claim; reservation writes never change on_hand_quantity.
